CHECKLIST_COMMENTS: Some comments on birding in La Silla for future birds there: Birds can be pretty sparse and few appart around the domes and the astronomer lodges. There is a really good spot where I saw most passerines in this list that is about 300m below the dining + office building. The spot is at coordinates 29°15'08.5" south and 70°44'31.7" west. On google maps, you can see that the rocks have a different colour, and this where the water from the residence and offices is discarded. This leads to a constant trickle of water and an area that is 30x10m in size full of little water puddles. The birds concentrate there in pretty large number and one can get very good pictures of most species, especially when sitting and waiting for birds to come for water. This is the spot for the turca and earthcreeper.

OBSERVATION_DETAILS: This was a very memorable observation. At the time in 2000, visiting birders could rent rooms at the  Rancho Grande station. On one night I decided to sleep on the upper "deck", close to where the bird feeders were, in hope of hearing owls at night. The guacharo actually woke me in the middle of the night, with the very loud clicking sounds just over my head. While it matched the description of the guacharo sound in my field guide, and it was clearly coming from a bird flying around in the dark, I asked the biologists working at the station the following morning if that was indeed a guacharo as I had never observed that bird before. They confirmed the identification and told me that the bird was regularly coming around the Rancho Grande pretty much all nights.

CHECKLIST_COMMENTS: Some comments on birding in La Silla for future birds there: Birds can be pretty sparse and few appart around the domes and the astronomer lodges. There is a really good spot where I saw most passerines in this list that is about 300m below the dining + office building. The spot is at coordinates 29°15'08.5" south and 70°44'31.7" west. On google maps, you can see that the rocks have a different colour, and this where the water from the residence and offices is discarded. This leads to a constant trickle of water and an area that is 30x10m in size full of little water puddles. The birds concentrate there in pretty large number and one can get very good pictures of most species, especially when sitting and waiting for birds to come for water. This is the spot for the turca and earthcreeper.

Évidemment, c'est un échappé! D'abord reconnu à son cri "yurp", puis vu au vol au-dessus du coin Fulton/Lemieux. Variété domestique blanche et non pas grise, tête jaune, silhouette élancée au vol, queue longue. Entre le merle et la tourterelle triste comme taille. Vol assez malhabile qui suggère que l'oiseau s'est échappé depuis peu.

Bien entendu et vue au vol au-dessus du quartier. Ventre gris, silhouette typique avec une longue queue, vol beaucoup plus maladroit que pour un oiseau sauvage, cri proche de celui du Tyran huppé. Coin Westbury et Jean-Brillant. Étrangement, j'ai vu la même espèce échappée au même endroit il y a 4 ans... j'espère que ce n'est pas le même propriétaire qui a perdu son oiseau!

Un individu trouvé dans les arbres de la cour d'honneur de l'université. L'oiseau a d'abord été repéré à son cri puis vu. L'oiseau était évidemment un échappé; avec une coloration des joues plus blanches que la forme sauvage qui a les joues jaune/orange.

CHECKLIST_COMMENTS: Some comments on birding in La Silla for future birds there: Birds can be pretty sparse and few appart around the domes and the astronomer lodges. There is a really good spot where I saw most passerines in this list that is about 300m below the dining + office building. The spot is at coordinates 29°15'08.5" south and 70°44'31.7" west. On google maps, you can see that the rocks have a different colour, and this where the water from the residence and offices is discarded. This leads to a constant trickle of water and an area that is 30x10m in size full of little water puddles. The birds concentrate there in pretty large number and one can get very good pictures of most species, especially when sitting and waiting for birds to come for water. This is the spot for the turca and earthcreeper.

Some comments on birding in La Silla for future birds there: Birds can be pretty sparse and few appart around the domes and the astronomer lodges. There is a really good spot where I saw most passerines in this list that is about 300m below the dining + office building. The spot is at coordinates 29°15'08.5" south and 70°44'31.7" west. On google maps, you can see that the rocks have a different colour, and this where the water from the residence and offices is discarded. This leads to a constant trickle of water and an area that is 30x10m in size full of little water puddles. The birds concentrate there in pretty large number and one can get very good pictures of most species, especially when sitting and waiting for birds to come for water. This is the spot for the turca and earthcreeper.

CHECKLIST_COMMENTS: Some comments on birding in La Silla for future birds there: Birds can be pretty sparse and few appart around the domes and the astronomer lodges. There is a really good spot where I saw most passerines in this list that is about 300m below the dining + office building. The spot is at coordinates 29°15'08.5" south and 70°44'31.7" west. On google maps, you can see that the rocks have a different colour, and this where the water from the residence and offices is discarded. This leads to a constant trickle of water and an area that is 30x10m in size full of little water puddles. The birds concentrate there in pretty large number and one can get very good pictures of most species, especially when sitting and waiting for birds to come for water. This is the spot for the turca and earthcreeper.

CHECKLIST_COMMENTS: Some comments on birding in La Silla for future birds there: Birds can be pretty sparse and few appart around the domes and the astronomer lodges. There is a really good spot where I saw most passerines in this list that is about 300m below the dining + office building. The spot is at coordinates 29°15'08.5" south and 70°44'31.7" west. On google maps, you can see that the rocks have a different colour, and this where the water from the residence and offices is discarded. This leads to a constant trickle of water and an area that is 30x10m in size full of little water puddles. The birds concentrate there in pretty large number and one can get very good pictures of most species, especially when sitting and waiting for birds to come for water. This is the spot for the turca and earthcreeper.

CHECKLIST_COMMENTS: Some comments on birding in La Silla for future birds there: Birds can be pretty sparse and few appart around the domes and the astronomer lodges. There is a really good spot where I saw most passerines in this list that is about 300m below the dining + office building. The spot is at coordinates 29°15'08.5" south and 70°44'31.7" west. On google maps, you can see that the rocks have a different colour, and this where the water from the residence and offices is discarded. This leads to a constant trickle of water and an area that is 30x10m in size full of little water puddles. The birds concentrate there in pretty large number and one can get very good pictures of most species, especially when sitting and waiting for birds to come for water. This is the spot for the turca and earthcreeper.
